en: "Fine. That's enough.{w}...I'm going to Rubenburg."{w}
"You're the one who'd better not end up blubbering later, Miria."{w}
"...No, I bet you don't.{w}
note: First half of a line that 4077 repeats inside {0E}..{0F}; the repeated English must stay identical.

en:
{0E}"...No, I bet you don't.{0F}
Because you're an IDIOT!!"{w}
note: {0E}..{0F} wraps the repeat of 4075; kept the source line break so the punchline lands on the next line as in 4075's {w}.

en:
"Wh-whoever calls someone an idiot is the real idiot!
Fine, don't you EVER come back! Bye-bye!!"{w}
note: Children's retort (baka tte itta hou ga baka) kept as a literal schoolyard comeback.

en: "Fine, goodbye! Fare thee well!!"{w}
note: otassha de is an old-fashioned farewell; 'Fare thee well' keeps the fogeyish ring that Miria mocks in 4083.

en: "Wh-what's with 'fare thee well'... You sound like an old granny!!"{w}
"Shut up, four-eyes!"{w}

"Soara's strong-willed, and once she's said something,
she won't listen to anyone..."{w}{p}"A few days after that talk, she'd moved out all on her own
and gone off to Rubenburg...{w}It was a real shock..."{w}{p}"And that's when I realized.{w}Because of my position, I thought I had to make a Training Hall
where everyone felt at home..."{w}{p}"But Soara wasn't part of that 'everyone'..."{w}{p}"I should have listened to her more...{w}I regret it a bit... No, I regret it a lot... you know."{w}{p}"If you ever go to Rubenburg,
could you go and see how Soara's doing?"{w}
note: Back to the present: Miria to the party. 'she' for Soara per glossary (female).

en: "Is your adventure going well?{w}Knowing when to pull back matters too, so be careful!"{w}

"Just a little while ago,
Soara went off to the Magic Bureau to give her regular report!{w}She looked so happy!"{w}{p}"Soara's dream came true, and I'm really, really happy for her!"{w}
"Soara, how's it feel to be adventuring again after so long?"{w}
"It's going pretty great!{w}Look at this map.{w}The world, you know... it's so much bigger than I ever thought!"{w}
note: daichi (the land/the continent) rendered 'the world' for the sense of discovery; literal: 'the land was this vast'.

en:
"Ooh!"{w}{p}"I wonder what kind of town Semnadoc is...{w}My parents took me to Isfald and Gandra
when I was a kid, though."{w}

"...Then, maybe on our next day off or something...
the two of us could... go there together.{w}There's this cute shop called the Caron Main Store, too..."{w}
"Really!? Let's go, let's go! It's a promise!"{w}
"Yeah, it's a promise!"{w}
Rondelgius

note: Hot-blooded coach parody voice (wagahai, 'hajikete miro'); kept loud and earnest.

en: Take the challenge?

note: kori ichigo = 'Ice Strawberry' (item name; also the strawberry shaved-ice flavour, which pays off in 4123-4127). Not in glossary.

en: "I shall await your return here.{w}I pray for your success."{w}
"What a spineless coward!{w}I thought better of you, you wretch!!"{w}

"What's the matter!
Your power can't be
this feeble!"{w}{p}"Go and get the Ice Strawberries
that grow wild on the Flotban Snowfield!"{w}{p}"Go! Go out there and cut loose!!"{w}
note: Refrain 'Ike! Itte, hajikete miro!' = 'Go! Go out there and cut loose!!' used identically in 4131, 4141, 4145, 4157.

en:
"Very good, well done!{w}So my will got through to you.
That makes me glad!"{w}{p}"Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll dig right in...{w}Crunch... crunch... Whoooa!?"{w}
"Mmmmmmm~~~!{w}
note: First half of 4127 (repeated inside {0E}..{0F}); savouring/brain-freeze groan.

en: {0E}"Mmmmmmm~~~! {0F}That's GOOD!!"{w}

"What's the matter!
Your power can't be
this feeble!"{w}{p}"Go and defeat that unknown apparition
that appears in Heerdahl!"{w}{p}"Go! Go out there and cut loose!!"{w}

note: sono kuukan no ihen: literal 'the anomaly of that space' (the bunker haunting); kept vague as in the source.

en:
"But how will you fare in the final trial?"{w}{p}"A true hero must know the power of nature,
and be able to conquer it!!"{w}{p}"The stage: the Churos Highlands.{w}At the very top, there's a spot
where a flag can be planted!!"{w}{p}"I shall give you this flag!{w}Plant the flag and conquer the Churos Highlands!
Do that, and the power of nature will be yours!!"{w}
"...Hm!?{w}You don't have any free space for items!?{w}No, no, that won't do! It has to be this flag!"{w}{p}"Go and make some room for items, then come back."{w}
note: dougu ni aki = free inventory slot; match the item-menu term once the UI is translated.

en:
"What's the matter!
Your power can't be
this feeble!"{w}{p}"Plant the flag on the Churos Highlands
and claim the power of nature!"{w}{p}"Go! Go out there and cut loose!!"{w}
"I have flags aplenty!{w}No need to hold back -- come on, take one!!"{w}
"Go! Go out there and cut loose!!"{w}

"Oh... Ohhh...!{w}What heroism! What spirit!!"{w}{p}"No one has ever succeeded at my trials,
and yet you have overcome every last one!"{w}
note: nanto iu yuusha, nanto iu tamashii: rendered as abstract nouns so the party's number stays open.

en:
"By the way, can you feel it?{w}The abominable power sleeping in the Churos Highlands."{w}{p}"It seems to have been slumbering until now,
but because you planted that flag...{w}...it's trying to wake up!!"{w}

"Hmmm. Even someone as great as I
never imagined anything like this.{w}Well now, this is a problem..."{w}
"......"{w}{p}"Right, you lot!{w}Go and find out what that presence really is."{w}{p}"That is my ultimate trial for you!{w}The finest-grade transmission of the soul! Be heroes, all of you!!"{w}
note: saikoukyuu no tamashii no dendou: 'dendou' (conduction) may be a pun on dendou (preaching); kept as 'transmission of the soul'. nanji, yuusha tare: archaic 'thou, be a hero' -> 'Be heroes, all of you!!'.

en:
"What's the matter?
Your power can't be
this feeble!"{w}{p}"Go and do something about
that abominable power in the Churos Highlands!"{w}{p}"Go! Go out there and cut loose!!"{w}
"So the Churos Highlands have settled down!{w}Well done, truly well done!!"{w}

note: Dragon Centaur V (doragon kentaurosu 5-sei): the monster at the Churos summit; not in glossary. 'V' for the regnal 5-sei.

en:
"...Now that the danger has passed,{w}I'll look into at least that much
myself."{w}
"How are you doing, my dear disciples!{w}I'm in fine form, as always!!"{w}
Haleorat

"What I'm proud of is that once I've heard a song,
I remember it and can play it right away."{w}{p}"Thanks to all my wandering,
there's not a song I can't reproduce these days."{w}{p}"...Although sometimes I slip up
and end up memorizing some drunk old guy's
humming instead."{w}{p}"I had an awful time of it in Gandra....{w}And in the end, there weren't even any girls."{w}
note: Accuracy: restored dropped subject (Haleorat is speaking of himself).

en:
"When you travel, you get to hear all sorts of songs:
old tales about the place, legends, hero sagas.{w}Sometimes you even brush up against hidden history!"{w}
"Hey! Wasn't there a hero saga about ME!?"{w}

"You're traveling all over this land, right?
Actually, I've got a little
favor to ask -- would that be okay?"{w}{p}"When I visited the goblins at Baroque Fort,
I heard the folks over at Anhimona
have the sheet music for an old song."{w}{p}"I really, really wanted it,
but I never got to meet whoever has the sheet music."{w}{p}"If your travels ever take you
to Anhimona,
could you look for that old sheet music while you're at it?"{w}

"If you find it,
I'll perform it for you as thanks!"{w}
"That sheet music...!?{w}Huh, it's not all here...{w}Sorry, but I can't sing it like this."{w}{p}"Come back again once you've got all of it."{w}

"So this is the sheet music
for the song handed down in Anhimona...!?{w}You finally got it -- thank you!!"{w}
The four pieces of sheet music became the Ancient Song!{w}
note: inishie no uta = 'Ancient Song' (key item); not in glossary. EVENT_TEXT quest title is 'yomigaere, inishie no uta' (suggest 'Revive the Ancient Song').

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the ?Ancient Song.{w}
note: Source puts a full-width '?' before the item name (possibly an 'unidentified' marker); kept as '?' -- check against the item menu.
seirei moji = 'Spirit Script' (seirei = Spirit per glossary); not in glossary.

en: "Fuhahahaha! It seems this is my moment to shine!"{w}
"Nobody called you.{w}...Uh, hey, Lord Volms."{w}
Lord Volms
"Hm. What is it?"{w}
"Have you ever seen writing like this before?{w}You've got antiques and all kinds of stuff, right?"{w}
note: Accuracy: restored subject/auxiliary (Haleorat asks Volms).

en: "Hmmmmmm... What rare letters these are.{w}And yet, I feel I've seen them somewhere..."{w}

note: Volms notices the party mid-conversation; drawn-out sneering delivery kept. Same insult recurs in 4268 (slice 018).

en: "Wait.{w}These may be the same letters as on that Forsaken Painting."{w}
note: haiga = 'Forsaken Painting' (coined term; lit. discarded/ruined painting); not in glossary, recurs in slices 018/039/046.

en: "Forsaken Painting?"{w}

note: Horobi no Asa = 'Morning of Ruin' (new name). The box-drawing glyphs are the unreadable Pyroglyph text and are kept verbatim (only the full-width spaces became ASCII); they are NOT ASCII -- the build must render them from the font or the orchestrator must swap in an ASCII stand-in.

en: "Where did you get that painting?"{w}
"Unfortunately, I know nothing of who the peddler was.{w}But they did say this script was called Pyroglyph."{w}
note: Peddler's gender unknown -> 'they'.

en: "Pyroglyph? I've never heard of it..."{w}
note: Accuracy: restored dropped subject (Haleorat).

en: "I know of it!"{w}
"Lord Rondelgius, is that true?"{w}
note: Rondelgius-dono -> 'Lord Rondelgius' (Volms's courtesy; matches his Dragon Lord title).

en: "...If you're lying, I'll smack you, old man."{w}

"I am not lying!{w}Pyroglyph is the oldest script of all, of unknown origin --
it even remains in the Dekor Temple Ruins!"{w}

"Seriously!?
Then you can read it, old man!?"{w}
"Show me!{w}...Fuhahaha, I can't read it at all!!"{w}
"If you can't read it, quit getting our hopes up like that..."{w}
